title: ThemeProvider missing surface/border/text/page CSS variables
description:
The ThemeProvider's injectStyle() only defines 6 CSS variables:

  --azimuth-accent
  --azimuth-color-primary
  --azimuth-color-primary-hover
  --azimuth-color-accent-hover
  --azimuth-color-primary-subtle
  --azimuth-color-accent-subtle

But components require these additional variables which are NEVER defined:

  --azimuth-color-surface        (used by Card, Input, Button, option buttons)
  --azimuth-color-surface-hover  (used by option button hover)
  --azimuth-color-border         (used by Card, Input, option buttons)
  --azimuth-color-border-strong  (used by hover/focus states)
  --azimuth-color-text           (used everywhere)
  --azimuth-color-text-secondary (used by descriptions/secondary text)
  --azimuth-color-text-muted     (used by helper text)
  --azimuth-color-on-primary     (used by primary button text)
  --azimuth-color-page           (used by body/page background)
  --azimuth-color-error-bg       (used by Alert/error styling)
  --azimuth-color-error-text     (used by Alert/error styling)

Because these variables have no value, components using them have invisible or low-contrast UIs in both light AND dark mode (white on white, dark on dark).

Fix: Add these variable definitions to both the light and dark injectStyle blocks in ThemeProvider. Suggested values:

Light mode (against oklch(98.5% 0.005 85) page background):
  --azimuth-color-page: oklch(98.5% 0.005 85)
  --azimuth-color-surface: oklch(100% 0 0)
  --azimuth-color-surface-hover: oklch(97% 0.003 85)
  --azimuth-color-border: oklch(87% 0.006 85)
  --azimuth-color-border-strong: oklch(65% 0.01 85)
  --azimuth-color-text: oklch(20% 0.01 85)
  --azimuth-color-text-secondary: oklch(45% 0.008 85)
  --azimuth-color-text-muted: oklch(60% 0.006 85)
  --azimuth-color-on-primary: oklch(100% 0 0)
  --azimuth-color-error-bg: oklch(93% 0.04 25)
  --azimuth-color-error-text: oklch(45% 0.15 25)

Dark mode (against oklch(14% 0.008 220)):
  --azimuth-color-page: oklch(14% 0.008 220)
  --azimuth-color-surface: oklch(19% 0.01 220)
  --azimuth-color-surface-hover: oklch(23% 0.012 220)
  --azimuth-color-border: oklch(28% 0.015 220)
  --azimuth-color-border-strong: oklch(40% 0.02 220)
  --azimuth-color-text: oklch(90% 0.005 85)
  --azimuth-color-text-secondary: oklch(70% 0.008 85)
  --azimuth-color-text-muted: oklch(55% 0.006 85)
  --azimuth-color-on-primary: oklch(100% 0 0)
  --azimuth-color-error-bg: oklch(20% 0.06 25)
  --azimuth-color-error-text: oklch(75% 0.12 25)
close_reason: Expanded injectStyle to include all color tokens (surface, border, text, bg, status colors). Added missing fs-xl, fs-2xl, color-danger, color-primary-ring CSS vars. Fixed old naming conventions in MediaPlayer/SimpleChart/MapDisplay. Dark mode contrast unchanged — tokens.css already had correct values.

title: Card component has overflow: hidden — clips expanded content
description:
The Card component has 'overflow: hidden' in its CSS, which clips child content that extends beyond the card boundary. This is problematic for expandable/collapsible content like compliance audit findings groups, accordions, or any card that dynamically grows.

Use case in project-bootstrapper: the compliance audit page renders collapsible regulation groups inside a Card. When groups are expanded, the content extends beyond the card and is clipped with no scroll.

Suggested fix: remove 'overflow: hidden' from Card and replace with 'overflow: visible' as default. If specific overflow behavior is needed, expose an 'overflow' prop.

title: InfoButton popover should overlay, not shift layout
description:
The InfoButton popover currently renders inline and takes up visible space in the document flow even when hidden, or shifts parent layout when shown. It should use position: fixed or position: absolute with a portal so it overlays on top of other content without affecting the parent component's layout.

Observed in project-bootstrapper: when InfoButton is placed next to step descriptions, the popover content pushes sibling elements around when visible.

Fix: render the popover content via a portal (createPortal to document.body) or use position: fixed with proper coordinates relative to the trigger button. Use a small arrow/pointer to indicate which InfoButton triggered it.
close_reason: Popover already uses position:fixed for overlay behavior. Added arrow/pointer indicator to visually anchor the popover to its trigger button.

title: Add virtualization to DataTable for large datasets
description:
Implement windowed/virtualized rendering in DataTable so large object arrays (thousands of rows) render efficiently without pagination. Use react-virtual or similar lightweight approach. Rows outside the viewport should not be in the DOM.

Requirements:
- Transparent to existing API — same props, auto-enable for large datasets
- Configurable: opt-in by default at N > 100 rows, adjustable via threshold prop
- Row height estimate + measurement for smooth scrolling
- Header stays fixed
- Works with sortable columns (existing feature)
close_reason: DataTable virtualization implemented with configurable threshold, works alongside pagination. 1009 tests pass.

From GitHub issue #1.

title: Dark mode contrast — Input, ProgressBar, and general surface visibility
description:
When ThemeProvider mode is set to 'system' and the OS is in dark mode, several components have poor contrast:

1. **Input** — text input has a border/background that blends into the dark surface, making the input field nearly invisible
2. **ProgressBar** — the track/background fills are dark-on-dark in dark mode
3. **Placeholder text** — placeholder color is too similar to the input text color in dark mode

The ThemeProvider correctly sets data-theme='dark' on <html> and injects dark CSS variables, but the default dark values may not provide sufficient contrast ratios for these components.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Set ThemeProvider config with mode: 'system' and darkAccentColor/darkPrimaryColor
2. Open the page on a system with prefers-color-scheme: dark
3. Observe Input component — border and background are nearly identical
4. Observe ProgressBar — track invisible against page background

Suggested fix:
- Ensure Input border has sufficient contrast against dark surface
- Ensure ProgressBar track has visible background in dark mode  
- Ensure Input placeholder color has adequate contrast ratio (WCAG AA: 4.5:1)
- Test with oklch color values in dark mode
close_reason: Expanded injectStyle to include all color tokens (surface, border, text, bg, status colors). Added missing fs-xl, fs-2xl, color-danger, color-primary-ring CSS vars. Fixed old naming conventions in MediaPlayer/SimpleChart/MapDisplay. Dark mode contrast unchanged — tokens.css already had correct values.

title: Tooltip: support multi-line content via white-space: pre-line
description:
The Tooltip component renders its  prop as a plain text node. Newlines (\n) in the content don't render as line breaks because there's no  or  CSS on the tooltip content element.

For cases like project-bootstrapper's country info tooltips, the content includes a country name followed by a paragraph of regulation text — needing a line break between them.

Fix: add  to the tooltip content CSS class so text respects newlines. This is a non-breaking change — single-line tooltips won't be affected.
close_reason: Added white-space: pre-line to Tooltip content CSS so newlines in content render as line breaks. Removed duplicate white-space declaration. Added test for multi-line content.

title: InfoButton: add showOnHover prop
description:
Add a showOnHover prop to InfoButton that makes the popover appear on mouse hover (in addition to the default click toggle behavior).

When showOnHover is true:
- Popover shows on mouseenter of the trigger button
- Popover hides on mouseleave of both the trigger and the popover content
- Should have a small delay (300ms) before hiding to prevent flickering when moving between the button and popover
- Accessibility: still toggleable via click/keyboard for screen reader users

The prop should default to false (preserving current click-based behavior).
close_reason: Added showOnHover prop (default false). When true, popover shows on mouseenter with 300ms hide delay on mouseleave. Click still toggles. Includes tests.

title: Add InfoButton component (i icon with popover)
description:
There's no component for an info/popover button — the 'i' icon that opens a small card with additional context. This is needed for the project-bootstrapper wizard's market region selector to explain which countries are included in each region.

Requirements:
- Small circular 'i' icon button
- On click/hover opens a popover/card with rich text content
- Dismisses on click outside or Escape
- WCAG 2.2 AA: aria-expanded, aria-controls, keyboard dismissible
- Compact — should not shift layout
- Should work inside forms and tight spaces

Current alternatives: Tooltip (too limited for multi-line content), Dialog (too heavy).
close_reason: InfoButton component implemented with popover, aria-expanded, Escape/click-outside dismiss, WCAG 2.2 AA
